messages:
alex: Heads-up — Vendor 'NexaSupply' sent a revised PO for Q2 top-off. Allocation cut: 48 -> 38 units, lead time 6-8 weeks, price +8% vs last commit. They flagged 12 units as DOA potential (pre-shipment test failures). Thoughts on acceptance vs pushing for replacement?
maria: Ugh. Did they provide a cause for the pre-shipment failures? any vendor test report or serial list?
chen: We need the serials and batch IDs. Also need to know if the DOA units are covered under warranty or they'd bill us for replacements.
linda: Logistics note — if we accept partial ship (38) we can air 12 priority units to EU depots, sea rest. But RMA flow for DOA will force returns to vendor depot in FRA, adds ~7 business days processing.
kevin: Customs / HS code: if we split air/sea, country of origin docs must match exactly or risk hold. Who can confirm docs?
sam: I can reach out to NexaSupply and ask for the full serial manifest and the pre-shipment test logs. Recommend we push for courier-photo evidence for the DOA units before they ship.
maria: price +8% — are we within our budget? what's the unit cost delta? link: https://redwood-internal/sheets/procurement/q2-gpu-commit (view only)
ops-bot: Shipping update: NexaSupply quoted insurance option +$1,200 per AWB for air, $600 per container for sea (optional).
alex: Budget check — +8% pushes unit cost up by ~$1,600 each. If we accept, Dedicated customers will see unit consumption change. Ops, can we absorb?
chen: From infra perspective: we need 30 usable h100-equivalents in EU by week 10. If lead time is 6-8w, margin is thin. Consider payment hold for the 12 flagged units until photos/logs + preflight test pass.
linda: RMA logistics: propose we require vendor to pre-create RMA labels for the 12 flagged units and prepay return freight. That avoids staging backlog on our side. Depot can hot-swap on arrival if paperwork done.
kevin: Also request HS reclassification confirmation in writing. Last time we had a 4-day hold because of mismatch.
sam: NexaSupply reply: "Can provide serial list + logs, but replacement ETA depends on stock in their repair pool; replacements might be 3-4 weeks after they receive DOA units."
maria: Option A: accept partial, pay premium, require pre-paid RMAs + photos + PO addendum for replacement SLA. Option B: push for full allocation or cancel. Which do we choose?
alex: My lean: Option A with conditions — we need enforceable SLA in writing and pre-paid RMA labels. Also approve insurance for the air tranche given the value.
chen: Agreed if vendor signs the PO addendum. Otherwise we trigger escalation to legal/sourcing.
linda: I'll block depot slots for week 10 if we go air. Need final by EOD so couriers can book.
kevin: I'll draft the HS confirmation email + customs attestation we can push to vendor.
sam: I'll get the serials + photo request sent now, cc'ing procurement and ops.
maria: Approved contingent: procurement signs addendum with replacement SLA (max 21 days for replacements) and pre-paid RMA. I'll draft the addendum and send to NexaSupply.
ops-bot: Note: created ticket PROC-8421 for PO addendum and RMA terms.
alex: Perfect. Let's keep the thread updated. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
